label: total length at hatching
comment: Measurement taken from representative image of hatched ophiopluteus

label: ultimate oral width
comment: Taken from different population study as others use disc diameter instead, which is not so stable, however max disc size also reported and this corresponds to that reported by the Swedish population studies

label: total length at metamorphosis
comment: Settlement length taken as proxy for metamorphosis

label: oral width at puberty
comment: Value calculated using original disc diameter (4mm) from JoseJens1992,and converting using the equation given in Table 1 of JoseJens 1992)

label: wet weight atb birth
comment: Calculated from guessed egg diameter of 0.1 mm: 4/3*pi*(0.01/2)^3

label: ultimate wet weight
comment: Value calculated from converting disc diameter to wet weight using equation given in JoseJens1992, Table1

label: wet weight at puberty
comment: Value calculated from converting disc diameter to wet weight using equation given in JoseJens1992, Table1

label: age at birth
comment: by d2 embryos have become ophiopleuteus larvae

label: life span
comment: average taken from long term study of same population (Ocklemannn & Muus, 1978

label: age at puberty
comment: average taken from long term study of same population (Ocklemannn & Muus, 1978)
